children: delivered 6.7% fewer vehicles in the third quarter amid an "operational reset" to match production with demand.
The electric vehicle maker delivered 3,806 vehicles in Q3, beating expectations for 3,709 deliveries, but produced only 2,954 compared to 3,891 vehicles produced in the same quarter last year.
The company eliminated the second shift at its Arizona facility and reduced its U.S. workforce by one-fifth in the wake of second-quarter results in which Lucid
reported a loss of $3.30 per share.

“The current consensus estimates for production and deliveries are based on operating models that no longer reflect the figures we anticipate today,” Lucid CEO Silvio Napoli said during the company’s second quarter earnings call, adding that production and delivery figures are expected to come in below the current consensus estimates.

also said it will hold a conference call with analysts on November 9 at 5:30pm ET following the release of third-quarter earnings, at which time the company is expected to report an adjusted loss of $2.31 per share on $443.66M in sales.
Shares are lower in after-hours trading after gaining nearly 1% during regular trading hours.

title: Lucid deliveries down 6.7% in Q3
